tweet.text: You described three red lines tonight and said they may evolve. In any serious governance framework, changing a red line triggers disclosure, review, and, ideally, external validation. Will OpenAI commit to publishing every future red line change with a public explanation and a mandatory notice period before it takes effect, the way regulated industries handle material policy amendments?
